= Smart Quotes and Verse Blocks

== Smart quotes

He whispered "`hello, world`" and walked away.

A '`single-quoted`' aside.

Don't get fooled — apostrophes in it's, you're, and don't stay literal.

Smart quotes can wrap formatting: "`emphasis is _here_`" and "`code is \`inside\``".

== Verse with attribution

[verse, Robert Frost, Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening]
____
The woods are lovely, dark and deep,
But I have promises to keep,
And miles to go before I sleep,
And miles to go before I sleep.
____
